name: Buddha Beans Coffee Co.
voice: Direct. Specific. Laid back. Warm, not soft. Plain verbs, short sentences. State things, don't puff them up. Coffee: lead with taste, smell, feel. CBD/CBG: factual, conversational, no medical claims, no miracle language.
_note: Fonts, logo, mascot and bag photo are not in this public repo. Run `python3 sync_brand.py /path/to/buddhabeans-theme` to build brands/buddhabeans/assets/. Without them scenes fall back to system fonts and no images. Colors come from the theme repo (plum, gold) and the bag label (coral).
